verdict.rationale: Weaviate's GitHub README lists Docker and Kubernetes deployment options alongside Weaviate Cloud and says it can be started locally with Docker. Its llms.txt calls it an open-source vector database, and a community user confirms it is open source and easy to run locally, even as an embedded Python package. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party self-hosting deployment and operations documentation in the pack; some add-ons (Query Agent, natural-language answers) are documented as Cloud only.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: Weaviate offers multiple installation and deployment options: Docker, Kubernetes, Weaviate Cloud
You can easily start Weaviate and a local vector embedding model with Docker.
Weaviate is an open-source vector database (Go) that stores objects, vectors, and inverted indexes
It is open source and fairly easy to get running locally
